t: Trump Says Denmark Gives US Control Over Greenland's Security
d: US President Donald Trump said Denmark had handed over control of Greenland's security to the United States.

t: US State Dept. Approves Sale of Air Defense Development Upgrades to Ukraine for $2.68 Billion

t: Kim Jong-un Inspects Defense Production Line
d: Kim Jong-un has inspected major munitions industrial enterprises in North Korea from September 16 to 18, according to KCNA.

t: Canada Refused to Extradite Ukrainian Nazi Veteran Hunka to Russia Twice
d: Canada has twice refused to extradite Ukrainian Nazi veteran Yaroslav Hunka to Russia and is not conducting its own investigation, Russian Ambassador to Canada Oleg Stepanov told RIA Novosti.
